title: Move the preference-based 'Assign Agent' action from Manage Ticket Queue to Crea
description:
[The user currently has the "Create Ticket" screen open (object support360_create_ticket, type T). Resolve "this", "this form/page/screen", or "here" to this object unless they name a different one.]

It should check "Preference" = "Category Name" like 'HARDWARE' = 'HARDWARE'. If it matches, the Agent for preferred category should get assigned. The status of that ticket should change from 'Pending' to 'Assigned'. And also the 'assigned_agent' and 'assigned_agent_name' should get filled with the agent who is assigned. Add an 'Assign Agent' action/button to Create Ticket that runs this preference-matching logic on demand for the open ticket. Replace the 'Assign Agent' action/button form 'Ticket Queue' transaction to 'Create Ticket' transaction.
